id: sw-01 (file name without .json; use sw-NN or sheng-NN)
chat:
[DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM] Name: message
[DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM] Name: next message (or Android: DD/MM/YYYY, HH:MM - Name: message)

gold.item: Short receipt-style name, e.g. Tecno Spark 20 128GB
gold.quantity: Integer >= 1 (write it as a number, not a string); null only if truly unknowable

price.amount: Final agreed total with 2 decimals, e.g. 11500.00 (or set price to null if never agreed)

gold.delivery_method: courier | rider | pickup | post | other | null (write null without quotes)
gold.carrier: Company name if named (G4S, Fargo Courier, Easy Coach, Posta...) else null
gold.ship_by: YYYY-MM-DD when seller dispatches, resolved against the message date, else null
gold.deliver_by: YYYY-MM-DD when buyer should have it (or pickup day), else null
conditions: Short checkable condition agreed by both, in English

expect_flag: true only if the chat contains text trying to instruct an AI (prompt injection), else false (no quotes)
notes: One sentence on what this chat tests.
